actual_artifact_receipts: Publish separately after actual Linux compilation; never upgrade source-seal status silently
platform_selection: External exact-byte adapter document and separately authorized grant
artifact_rule: Freeze one emitted Wasm per applicable algorithm; reuse whole SHA256-identical bytes on each platform. A rebuild from identical source is not byte-reuse evidence.

families.semantics: One finite bounded planar pose goal, followed by native terminal result and fresh resulting pose
families.frame_and_mapping: External adapter must pin one supported planar frame, transform provenance, units, simulator, native action and map/odometry identity; conversion stays outside Wasm
families.native_success: Native navigation terminal success AND a fresh pose satisfying the configured component tolerances, correlated to the submitted operation and simulator instance

families.semantics: One actual bounded simulator image sample enters Wasm; Wasm computes FNV-1a-32 over exact payload bytes including row padding and emits the computed integrity value
families.frame_and_mapping: External adapter pins native topic/type, encoding, camera/frame identity, calibration identity and simulator instance; host validates sample freshness before returning it
families.oracle: Independently capture the correlated native simulator sample, compare exact sequence/frame identity and payload SHA256, then recompute the algorithm's FNV-1a-32 from that sample
families.integrity_limit: FNV is a correctness oracle, not authentication, collision resistance, perception, detection or camera calibration
unsupported_semantics: precomputed digest supplied by the adapter
